decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension and garage hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing house.

Condition : 4 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The garage or car parking accommodation shown on drawings No.s PR/106/PL2, PL5, PL6 shall thereafter not be used for any purpose other than the parking of vehicles in connection with the residential use of 1 Royston Close..
description: Erection of a single storey side and rear extension, conversion of existing garage into habitable room and the erection of new garage in font of house.
